arStrings.szText:
{icon:bullet,1.2} When you Cast {c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c}, unleash all {c_important}Ultimates{/c}, triggering {c_important}Heaven's Fury{/c} and {c_important}Fortress{/c} and replacing {c_important}Arbiter of Justice{/c} with {c_important}Zenith{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} Gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%x|]{/c} increased damage with {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skills for the duration of Arbiter of Justice. 
{icon:bullet,1.2} All {c_important}Ultimates{/c} are also {c_important}Disciple{/c} Skills.
